name: SKI (ALPHA)
desc:
*BETA*

SKI is a hardcore, fast-paced skiing game.

Reaching the bottom isn’t easy,learn the controls, keep your speed, and avoid crashing.

Race friends, find the fastest lines, send huge jumps, land tricks, and chase world records. Every mistake costs time.

🎿 CONTROLS
WASD / Arrow Keys / Left Stick — Ski
Space / A — Jump
Scroll / Pinch / Right Stick — Change Camera

🔥 TRICKS
Keyboard — Double Tap WASD / Q or E
Mobile — Swipe right side / Hold or Double Tap Jump
Controller — D-Pad / X

Private server owners can change course length and difficulty from the top bar.

👍 Like and favorite for new skis, features, and updates
